verdict: A real lead burst arrived late in the week; scale-up is blocked pending overdue milestones.
narrative: After 13 consecutive days with no leads, 9 leads came in across October 15–17, driving a sharp weekly spike — this movement is real, not an artifact. In the last 28 days you received 24 leads total, all from Meta, at a cost of $66.26 per lead; Google Ads recorded 8 conversions separately, but those are not yet flowing into lead attribution because conversion tracking is being repaired. The more pressing issue is that several planned milestones — including heating campaign activation, LSA re-enable, and intake owner confirmation — remain unresolved, which is holding back any meaningful scale. Clearing those milestones is the immediate priority, and the budget re-raise planned for October 31 is contingent on it.
